column1: # Every host the installer knows, one fact per row. Read by install.sh, install.ps1,
# sync.sh, and validate.sh; nothing else carries a host path.
# scope    project (--target DIR) or global (--global, paths under $HOME)
# profile  the name a user passes to the installer
# kind     block   = shared file that receives the managed block (user content kept)
#          owned   = dedicated file this package owns and replaces
#          skill   = folder that receives a copy of skills/clean-code
#          include = apply another profile of the same scope (aliases and bundles)
# path     relative to the target; owned files are copied from the same path in this repo
# detect   1 when the presence of this path means the profile is installed (--detect)
# .agents/skills is the shared cross-agent skill root: Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI,
# and Amp all read it. Grok Build CLI reads AGENTS.md but keeps its own root, .grok/skills.
# Antigravity uses the shared project root and a personal root under the Gemini config dir.
